mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points within 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.3pp in 3 months), or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate hikes above 5.0% and unemployment rate increases above 4.0% create stagflationary pressure, suppressing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1500 thousand units indicate robust residential investment, signaling strong consumer confidence and increased disposable income, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 100 (index) indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals central bank reluctance to ease policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a synchronized housing market expansion, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE below 3.5%) fuels wage growth and consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
